Method of Attack: Content filtering functionality broken by limiting blocking capabilities of webRequest API
Phasing out 'webRequest' API in favor of 'declarativeNetRequest' API which restricts filtering capabilities
Limiting filters to 30,000 entries and promoting static filtering compatible with AdBlock Plus
Restricting extension capabilities through Manifest V3 changes
Attack Vector: Changes in Chrome extension manifest version 3 restricting webRequest API
Indicators of Compromise: Blocking options removed from most webRequest events
Use of declarativeNetRequest API as primary content-blocking API
Incompatibility with various filtering designs used by uBlock Origin and uMatrix
